learning_outcomes.text: To prove the ability to solve independently (under the leadership of the supervisor and consultants) the given problem in the field of aerospace technology and to submit it in the form required for bachelor thesis.

syllabus_topics: Structural design of a selected part of the airplane structure
Creation of a 3D model of the designed structure
Proposition and execution of the experiment with designed part of structure (if required)
Working out of the bachelor work
bibliography: D. P. Raymer: Aircraft Design: A Conceptual Approach, AIAA Education Series, Washington 1989, ISBN 0-930403-51-7
Other literature - Assigned by the supervisor of bachelor thesis according to assigned theme
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
